title: SHMI_Yield: analysis code and data for "Soil health tracks management systems, not the sum of individual practices"
description: Code and derived data reproducing the analyses in Moore and Manter (in review): the soil-health structural equation model, calibration and cross-validation of the Soil Health Management Index (SHMI) on 354 US systems at 74 NAPESHM sites, the SHAPE benchmark, practice labels against SHMI, the within-site corn and soybean yield analyses at ten long-term experiments (DRIVES and AgCROS), year-condition and drought tests, and the coarse-record test. Includes the SHMI workbooks for all experiments, cached public downloads (NASS, WorldClim, Daymet, SPEI), the rules and code that convert AgCROS tables to SHMI workbooks, and a targets pipeline that reruns the yield analyses and display items. Raw AgCROS tables are not redistributed. Scores are computed with the SHMI R package, version 2.0.0.
